capabilities.why: Safety hooks intercept every command before VM dispatch, evaluating against strict security policies and blocking malicious commands like exfiltration and destructive root deletes.
Network policies enforce egress rules on the microVM sandbox, completely disabling outbound internet access to prevent sensitive token or secret exfiltration during untrusted code execution.
Snapshots capture full filesystem and memory state prior to untrusted execution, allowing instant deterministic rollback when an unexpected error or unsafe condition is detected.
